description_for_human: Speech AI: generate natural voice, transcribe with timing, remove noise. Uzbek, Russian, English.
description_for_model: VoiceLab provides text-to-speech (WAV 24kHz), speech-to-text with word timing and speaker labels, voice isolation with noise removal, and LLM completions.
